description: FR-008: Agent-Based Domain Explorer — discover domain concepts via AI agent with active codebase exploration, tool use, and cost controls

userStories.title: Add agent types, interfaces, and config fields
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the type system and config schema to support the agent-based discovery mode so that subsequent stories can build on a stable foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add AgentConcept interface to types.ts: { concept: string; definition: string; signals: Signal[] }
Add Signal interface to types.ts: { type: string; value: string; file?: string }
Add explorer_model, agent_max_files, agent_max_context_tokens to DomainLensConfig type
Update init command: generated config.json includes explorer_model ('anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6'), agent_max_files (150), agent_max_context_tokens (100000)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement agent tool handlers
userStories.description: As an AI agent runner, I need a set of filesystem/search tools so that the LLM can actively explore the codebase during discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/agent/tools.ts implementing five tools: list_directory, glob_files, read_file, search_text, read_schema
list_directory(path): lists immediate children of a directory, respects config ignore list
glob_files(pattern): finds files matching a glob pattern within code_paths, respects ignore list
read_file(path, offset?): reads up to 500 lines; offset param skips that many lines for pagination; returns line count info
search_text(query, path?): returns file:line matches for query string within code_paths (or path if provided), respects ignore list
read_schema(): returns the JSON string from .domainlens/schemas/latest.json, or empty object if not found
All tools export a getToolDefinitions() returning OpenAI-compatible tool definitions array
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement agent runner loop with cost controls
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an agent runner that manages the LLM session, invokes tool calls in a loop, and enforces file and token limits so that exploration is cost-controlled.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/agent/runner.ts exporting runAgent(config, projectPath, existingSkills, options): Promise<AgentConcept[]>
Runner sends initial system prompt containing: extracted schema JSON, list of existing skill names, code_paths, ignore list, and instruction to call finish() when done
Runner uses explorer_model from config; falls back to llm_model if explorer_model is absent
Runner loops: calls LLM, handles tool_use responses by dispatching to correct tool handler, feeds tool_result back
finish(concepts) tool call ends the loop and returns concepts
Tracks file_reads counter (increments on each read_file call) and accumulated input tokens
When file_reads reaches agent_max_files: print soft-cap summary and prompt user 'Continue reading? [y/N]'; if 'y', continues loop; if 'n', calls finish with current partial concepts
When accumulated tokens exceed agent_max_context_tokens: stops loop and returns partial concepts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add real-time progress display and fault tolerance
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to see what the agent is doing in real time and have partial results saved on failure so that agent sessions are transparent and recoverable.
acceptanceCriteria: When agent runs, print header: '▶ Agent exploring codebase...'
Print each tool invocation as: '  → tool_name arg_summary' (e.g., '  → read_file src/services/billing.ts')
When finish() is called print: '  ✓ Done — N files read, M concepts found'
On API error, timeout, or unhandled exception: save any AgentConcepts already collected as skills (partial save) before rethrowing the error
Partial-save path calls the same generateDomainSkills() that normal flow uses, with dryRun=false
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wire --agent flag into discover command and CLI
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to run 'domainlens discover --agent' to replace regex scanning and heuristics with an AI agent that actively explores the codebase.
acceptanceCriteria: Add agent?: boolean to DiscoverOptions interface in discover.ts
When agent=true: skip code scanner steps (scanSqlExamples, scanConstantsAndEnums, scanOrm) and inferConcepts; call runAgent() instead to get AgentConcept[]
Schema extraction (step 1) and doc extraction (step 4) still run when --agent is set
generateRulesSkills() still runs when --agent is set
enrichConcept() is NOT called in agent mode (definition comes from agent)
When --force is set with --agent: do not pass existing skills to agent context (agent rediscovers from scratch)
Add --agent flag to the 'discover' command in cli.ts
Typecheck passes
